scope: Attention component exploration; not HTTP latency or image-quality qualification.

manifest.scope: New prompts not taken from acceptance assets; diagnostic-only capture; no HTTP timing claim

request.prompt: A red ceramic teapot beside three green pears on a blue linen tablecloth, soft morning window light, detailed still life photograph.
An old wooden fishing boat resting on a quiet pebble beach under a cloudy violet sky, distant lighthouse, wide landscape photograph.

capture.tensor_availability: Raw tensors retained locally, not included in this export.

limitations: Synthetic density excludes mask construction and importance ranking; it is only an operator cost screen.
Real captures cover two new 1024-square prompts, rank0, blocks0/25/49 and steps0/5; they do not cover the full frozen workload.
Component output error includes all packed rows, including padding. It does not establish image acceptance.
Including eager importance-mask construction made every captured case slower. Compiling FP32 TopK masks was exact relative to eager FP32 masks but did not improve the synthetic total cost.
No sparse candidate entered whole-model quality validation.

failed_attempts.reason: Passed cumulative FAS boundaries to BlockSparseAttention, which expects individual document lengths. The first operation failed tiling; all subsequent samples from that process are invalid and excluded.
failed_attempts.resolution: Fresh process, convert lengths, check finite nonzero reference, and stop immediately after any backend error.

failed_attempts.reason: GE TopK did not support BF16 input in the installed stack. Stopped after first error.
failed_attempts.resolution: Fresh-process retry with FP32 ranking scores, preserving BF16 Q/K/V.
